page.layout: One column of running text on a single page. Running head at top, printed page number at top left. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: redemtionem per sanguinem ipsius, redemtionem scilicet peccatorum. 1. Timoth. 2. v. 6. Hic per proprium sangui-nem ingressus est semel in sacrarium æternam redemtionem nactus. Hebr. 9. Proinde dignus est, qui accipiat librum & aperiat sigilla ejus: quoniam macta-tus est, & redemit nos Deo per sanguinem suum. Apoc. 5. [?] v. 9. Deinde manifestum est, Sanctos Martyres suo etiam sanguine profuso veritatem cœlestem obsignasse, & hac ratione Ecclesiæ sa-lutem non parum promovisse, qui tamen hominum Servatores dici nō meruerunt. Sanctus Paulus 2. Corinth. 1. v. 5. 6. ait: Sicut abundant perpessiones Christi in nobis: Ita per Christum etiam abundat consolatio nostra: sive enim premimur, id fit pro vestra consolatione ac salute, qua efficitur in tolerantia earundem perpessionum, quibus & nos afficimur: sive consolationem accipimus, id fit pro vestra consolatione ac salute: & spes nostra firma est de vobis, quod sciamus vos, sicut socii estis perpessionum: Ita etiam socios fore consolationis. Coloss. 1. v. 14. Nunc gaudeo de iis quae patior pro vobis, & reliquias afflictionum Christi vicissim [?] expleo in carne mea pro corpore

page.notes: The catchword "ipsum" at the lower right is not part of the text. Doubtful readings: "Apoc. 5." (the numeral looks like an long-s form, copied as 5 with [?]); "vicissim" (the word is hard to read at this size, copied with [?]). Italic runs are marked. The page has no paragraph breaks: every line is full, so the text runs on as one paragraph. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept.
